# NovoTech Machine Tools Inc.

> Metalworking and metal fabrication machinery supplier in Mississauga, ON, Canada. Sells, installs and supports press brakes, laser cutters, shears, ironworkers, plate rollers, angle rolls, bandsaws, cold saws, rebar benders and cutters, pipe benders, hydraulic presses, punching machines, bevelers, deburring and finishing machines, notchers and press brake tooling. Machines are supplied with CSA-approved electrical panels and supported with spare parts and technical support from Canada.

Contact: +1 647 526 5510 · info (at) NovoTechMachineTools.com · 1365 Mid-Way Blvd, Unit 26, Mississauga, ON L5T 2J5, Canada.
NovoTech is appointing independent sales agents and dealers in cities and provinces across Canada; enquiries through the quote form on any product page or by phone.
Social: YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@NovoTechMachineTools · LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/novotech-machine-tools-inc/ · Facebook https://www.facebook.com/novotechmachinetoolscanada · Instagram https://www.instagram.com/novotech_machinetools/
Brands represented include GMS GöçMakSan (rebar machinery), Dener (press brakes, shears, lasers), Senfeng (fiber lasers, laser welders), ISITAN, Bekamak, Pilous, Gecam, CKEMSA, LFSS, Cevisa and EUROSTAMP tooling.

## Product pages

- [Rebar benders and rebar cutters (overview)](https://novotechmachinetools.com/rebar-bender-and-cutter): every GMS rebar machine NovoTech supplies, with a single-bar capacity table for the whole range.
- [Rebar benders](https://novotechmachinetools.com/rebar-bender): stationary B and BS series benders (Ø1″–Ø2-3/8″ / 26–60 mm), portable MG and BT benders on 110/220 V, SL stirrup benders, SX and AXIS 50S spiral benders, dowel bar benders, the MAX 40 combined bender-cutter and HB/MH mesh machines — specification tables in inches and millimetres, photos and videos.
- [Rebar cutters](https://novotechmachinetools.com/rebar-cutter): hydraulic H series (H 26–H 55), mechanical M series (M 36–M 55), double-acting SH 45 and SH 60, and the portable POWER 24 — cutting capacities for one or two bars at 45/65/85 kg/mm² steel.
- [Automatic rebar processing lines](https://novotechmachinetools.com/automatic-rebar-processing-lines): SLS 12 CNC stirrup bender from coil, MATRIX 55 / 55S shear lines, SYNCLONE 45S servo double bender — technical specifications, capacities and videos.
- [Plate rollers & slip rolls (overview)](https://novotechmachinetools.com/plate-rollers): ISITAN plate rolling machines — hydraulic 4-roll and 3-roll plate rollers, motorized plate rolls and motorized slip rolls from 3.4 ft to 10.2 ft, capacity table for all 134 models, plate roller buying guide.
- [Hydraulic 4-roll plate rollers](https://novotechmachinetools.com/hydraulic-4-roll-plate-rollers): ISITAN 4R HMS 650–3100 (2.1–10.2 ft, plate to 1/2″) and 4R OM / HOM corrugated-sheet rolls; NovoTech premium-line 4R HS-L linear (3.4–6.7 ft), 4R HS orbital (5.1–13.5 ft, to 1″), heavy-duty 4R HSS (6.7–20 ft, plate to 3-3/8″), NC cassette-type 4RH and 4R HC cone rolls — all with NC / CNC, crane, side-support and ejector options.
- [Hydraulic 3-roll plate rollers](https://novotechmachinetools.com/hydraulic-3-roll-plate-rollers): ISITAN MRM-H initial-pinch rolls 650–3100 (2.1–10 ft, to 1/2″) and 3R HMD; NovoTech premium line double-pinch 3R HS 20-210 – 30-280 (6.7–10.2 ft, to 1-1/8″) and translating 3R UHS 30-450 – 30-680 (10.2 ft, plate to 3-1/2″).
- [Motorized 3-roll plate rollers](https://novotechmachinetools.com/motorized-plate-rollers): ISITAN MRM-S 1050–3050 (21 models, composite-panel version), IRM 1050–2550, RM 1050–2050.
- [Bead rollers & beading machines](https://novotechmachinetools.com/bead-rollers): ISITAN HIBKS / IBKS 4.0 and 2.5 hydraulic and motorized bead rollers (8 ga and 12 ga), IBKS 1.8 and IKM / IKMP 1.2 motorized bead rollers — roll sets, specification tables in inches.
- [Circle cutting machines, flanging machines & lock seamers](https://novotechmachinetools.com/circle-cutters-and-seamers): ISITAN IDK-1.8 to IDK-5 motorized and hydraulic circle shears (discs to Ø78.7″ in 3/16″) and LS-13P lock seamer; NovoTech premium-line SDK 6 / SDK 8 circular cutting and flanging machines for tank heads to Ø15 ft in 5/16″ plate and the EFM 6 elliptical cutting and flanging machine.
- [Press brakes — every line NovoTech sells (hub)](https://novotechmachinetools.com/press-brake): the three press-brake pages introduced separately — Dener CNC press brakes (premium, Turkey), NovoTech CNC press brakes (value line, hydraulic + electric + NC) and ISITAN compact hydraulic press brakes — with one capacity table for all 14 families (bending force, length, stroke, daylight, weight) and a buying FAQ: which line, hydraulic / hybrid / electric, tonnage, CNC vs NC, tooling, Ontario pre-start review.
- [Dener CNC press brakes — hydraulic, hybrid, servo-electric and ball-screw](https://novotechmachinetools.com/dener-cnc-press-brakes): Dener XL hydraulic CNC press brakes (18 models, 66 – 661 US tons × 5 – 20 ft; ESA S640 / S875 W or Delem DA-66S / 69S; tandem to 60 ft and 1,800 tons), XH hybrid press brakes (SVP 60 – 400 servo-pump packages on the XL frame, 42 – 58 % energy saving), DDM servo-electric press brakes (9 models, 44 – 220 US tons × 5 – 13.4 ft, no hydraulic oil) and DDS ball-screw electric press brakes (DDS 2090 / 4013, 22 and 44 US tons) — bending force, length, stroke, daylight, speeds, motor, dimensions and weight in imperial (metric); standard and optional equipment, back gauges to 6 axes, tooling; two brochure PDFs.
- [Sheet metal fiber laser cutting machines](https://novotechmachinetools.com/laser-cutting-machine): Dener GFL production fiber lasers (3015 / 4020 / 6020, 1.5 G, 394 ft/min, pallet changer, 3 – 40 kW) and Smart series — closed-type double table (3015 – 12526), semi-closed single table (6025 – 25040, to 13 × 82 ft) and open-type (3015 – 6020, 3 – 6 kW) — working areas, sources, speed, acceleration; laser power guide, assist gas, automation; brochure PDF. Below Dener, the Senfeng value line under its own brand: compact enclosed lasers (SF1313G, SF1530G / N / NP, SFP600 – 1250), NP open-type single-table lasers (SF3015NP – SF6020NP, 3 – 12 kW), H series enclosed lasers with pallet changer (HC 1.5 – 12 kW, H4 6 – 30 kW to 8.3 × 40 ft, H5 heavy-load 12 – 80 kW), HM sheet + tube combination lasers, R / TX / TXP plate gantries to 10 × 164 ft with ±45° bevel and laser + flame, SF3015TD five-axis 3D laser and RC robot cells, coil-fed laser lines; Senfeng brochure PDF.
- [Tube and profile laser cutting machines](https://novotechmachinetools.com/tube-laser-cutting-machine): Dener E-FTL (chucks 120 / 180 / 250 / 350, Ø0.3″ – 13.8″, 1 G, 394 ft/min) and FTL (chucks 250 / 350 / 500 / 640, Ø0.6″ – 25.2″, bars to 12 m and 2,600 kg) tube lasers, 3 – 20 kW, bundle loaders, following supports, bevel heads; brochure PDF. Below Dener, the Senfeng value line: T series two-chuck tube lasers (SF6012T – SF12035T, SF7012T – SF7524T, Ø0.5″ – 14.1″, 20 – 39 ft, 1.5 – 6 kW), PLUS high-speed and GPLUS / GT 45° bevel tube lasers, NT three-chuck zero-tailing, ST three-chuck and HT four-chuck heavy-duty tube lasers to Ø25.1″, 6,600 lb and 49 ft, SF1500CH H-beam profile line; Senfeng brochure PDF.
- [CNC panel benders — 47 to 165″ bend width](https://novotechmachinetools.com/panel-bender): Dener panel bender DB 2017 (blanks to 78.7 × 49.2″, 15 servo axes, 0.2 s per bend) and the NovoTech value-line PB-M press-arm panel benders (9 models, 63 – 165″, 15 axes) and PB-A automatic tool-change panel benders (4 models, 64 – 126″, 26 – 28 axes) — 14 ga mild steel, 16 ga stainless, 1/8″ aluminum; robot loading cells. Senfeng BDC push-down panel benders BDC1500 – BDC3200 (59 – 126″, 13 – 16 servo axes, 14 ga mild steel) and suction-cup BDC1200 / BDC1500 (47 – 59″, 20 ga), robot loading cells; Senfeng brochure PDF.
- [Laser welding machines — handheld, robotic and laser cladding](https://novotechmachinetools.com/laser-welding-machine): Senfeng S series portable air-cooled handheld laser welders (SF3S / 4S / 5S, 0.8 – 1.5 kW, 99 – 121 lb, 220 V single-phase), HWM handheld laser welders (SF1500 / 2000 / 3000HWM, welds to 9/32″, 4-in-1 weld / clean / cut / seam head), RW robotic laser welding cells (SF1500RW – SF20000RW, 1.5 – 20 kW, 6-axis robot, positioners), SF-500RMW teaching-free and 350 / 500CMW cobot MIG welders, laser cladding machines (SFR6063 robot cell, SFHS3050 / 6050 lathe-type, SFMR02 portable, 6 / 12 kW) — specification tables, FAQ, brochure PDF.
- [Compact hydraulic press brakes](https://novotechmachinetools.com/compact-hydraulic-press-brakes): ISITAN Edgebender 1230 / 1540 / 2160 NC 2-axis press brakes (33–66 US tons, 4.2–6.9 ft) and the Edgebender 1240 CNC 3-axis with Cybelec Cybtouch 12 — Promecam tooling, Leuze light guard, specification tables in inches.
- [NovoTech CNC press brakes — hydraulic and electric, value line](https://novotechmachinetools.com/novotech-cnc-press-brakes): NovoTech value-line press brakes built in China to North American standards — CNC press brakes WAD 50 – 300 t (55 – 331 US tons, 4 – 20 ft) with Delem DA-53T control, Hawe servo valves, linear scales, servo back gauge and CNC crowning; heavy-duty WAD 400 – 1,200 t (441 – 1,323 US tons, 13 – 26 ft) and tandems; NC torsion-bar press brakes WC67K/E 30 – 400 t (33 – 441 US tons) with Estun E21 control. Specification tables in inches, FAQ on CNC vs NC and tonnage; electric press brakes WADG 10 – 160 t (11 – 176 US tons, 20″ – 10.5 ft) — servo motors, timing belts and dual lead ball screws, no hydraulics, ± 0.01 mm, Delem DA-53T, X-R back gauge; compact WADG 3 / 6 / 12 t bench machines; robot bending cells.
- [Pipe benders & tube bending machines (overview)](https://novotechmachinetools.com/pipe-benders): every ISITAN tube and pipe bender — CNC and NC mandrel benders, compact and aluminum-profile benders, BK rotary draw benders — with a capacity table for the whole range.
- [CNC tube benders](https://novotechmachinetools.com/cnc-tube-benders): ISITAN SFB 38 / 51 / 65 / 76 / 90-CNC/A3 3-axis and SFB 38 / 51 / 65-CNC/A5 5-axis servo mandrel benders, Ø1-1/2″ to Ø3-1/2″ × 8 ga, 21″ touchscreen CNC with 3D simulation.
- [NC tube benders](https://novotechmachinetools.com/nc-tube-benders): ISITAN SFB 38 – 90-NC hydraulic mandrel benders with 10″ touchscreen NC, SFB NC/C carrier models with servo rotation, SFB 32-HD / 32-M compact benders, SFB 38-NC/A aluminum-profile benders.

- [Tube notchers & pipe notching machines](https://novotechmachinetools.com/pipe-notcher): ISITAN PN 17/90 and PN 20/76 belt-sander pipe notchers (11/16″ to 3-1/2″ OD, any angle to 50°, ten dovetail drums included) and the TD-01 tube-end deburring machine.
- [Tube end forming machines — expanding, reducing, beading and flanging](https://novotechmachinetools.com/tube-end-forming-machines): ISITAN SFF 90-1 / SFF 60-1 single-station hydraulic end formers (expand and reduce tube ends to Ø3-1/2″ × 14 ga, tooling set included) and the Wecotech (Switzerland) range — Easy line Tubex expander / Tubin reducers / Tubepress / Tubepunch, Universal line Tubex-U, Tubin-U, Tubax-U axial, Tubax-Rotary Electra, Tubax-Multi forming centre, Tubiroll-2R beading machine to Ø39.4″, Traditional line Tubimatic C and IO 80 / IO 160 (hydraulic and Electra) for standard C and IO tools, Weco line Tubex IO-S, Wecomatic IO-S 200 / Speed / High Speed CNC radial formers to Ø23.6″ and the flanging cell, plus Tubecut IO-S, Tubeshear and Rotobrush — specifications in imperial (metric), options, brochure PDF.

- [Hydraulic punching machines](https://novotechmachinetools.com/hydraulic-punching-machines): NovoTech premium-line HPM 30–175 single-head punches (33–193 US tons, holes Ø1/4″–2-1/4″, throat to 24.6″), HPM 65–175 DP double-head, HPM 85 / 115 / 175 CNC with 120 × 20″ Siemens table and HPM / HKM NC punching and cutting lines.

Specification tables in inches.
